{"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.affix.tinglv-contained-impact","name":"敛震","kind":"affix","scope":"equipment","version":3,"description":"霆律击伤活敌并由振切真耗旧雷后，使其冲击力降低所示比例，持续1.2秒。同类削冲取最强、各自计时；同名弱者不续时。不减生命伤害，不保证等比减距或免于打断。","iconGuid":"9850a753-8cdf-5667-a586-9e957687c474","families":["control.consumed-thunder-impulse"],"mechanism":{"kind":"affix","parameters":{"stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"player","modules":["returning-sword"],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["atlas-s30"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"module-gated","moduleEvidence":"霆律敛震私有耗雷词；装备准备核验本器、效果身份、原词值与消费工序。"},"eligibility":{"id":"affix.roll.tinglv-contained-impact","name":"敛震","systems":["returning-sword"],"introducedInPoolVersion":3,"definitionVersion":1,"balanceVersion":1,"comparableRuleVersion":1,"ownerEquipmentId":"atlas-s30","slot":"suffix","unit":"percent","stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","visualSignal":"rune","consumer":{"capability":"sword-tuning","version":4},"recordPolicy":"higher","allowedKinds":["weapon"],"poolKinds":["weapon"],"poolFamilies":["returning-melee"],"scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"minRarity":2,"minimumItemLevel":1,"selectionWeight":0.65,"budgetCost":10,"maximumEffectiveValue":0.25,"conflicts":[],"contactStatus":{"statusId":"tinglv-contained-impact","trigger":"consumed-status","consumedStatusId":"thunder-mark"}}}},"strength":[{"field":"value","label":"敌人冲击力降低比例","formula":{"kind":"affix-range","definitionId":"affix.roll.tinglv-contained-impact","baseValue":0.1,"valuePerTier":0.01,"operation":"increased","unit":"降低比例（0.1表示冲击力乘0.9）","levels":{"min":1,"max":100,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[{"targetId":"effect.affix.tinglv-delayed-cadence","weight":0.1,"reason":"不同受体或属性的短窗互补，不互相触发或续时。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.tinglv-thunder-guard","weight":0.2,"reason":"同一成功耗雷可分别削敌冲击、保护主人生命，两个受体；不再耗一枚印。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s30.continuous-returning-strike","weight":0.4,"reason":"霆律主击提供真实接触，但须到达仍带旧雷的活敌；后缀不是裸剑固有能力。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s30.marked-vibration-cut","weight":1,"reason":"本器振切实际移除旧雷是直接触发凭据；敛震不再消费一次雷痕。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s30.seek-marked-first","weight":0.6,"reason":"优先追印有助于找到前置目标，雷痕仍可能在抵达前被别剑消费。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s29.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.9,"reason":"逐电刻雷而不自行耗雷，是霆律需要的外部前置来源；不改变削冲比例。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s23.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.65,"reason":"鎏炎刻雷可留给霆律；其后道耗火与雷痕消费分开，火印不算敛震前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s24.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.6,"reason":"汽焰锁刻雷提供旧印，前段破膜是否成功不替代实际供雷。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s26.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.6,"reason":"沸潮封刃实际刻下的雷可供振切；无水膜也可供雷，不能把汽压破膜称为耗雷。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s28.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.5,"reason":"归炉后道留雷能供应振切；其他五行工序不重复强化敛震。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.4,"reason":"藏夜收割后新刻的雷只支持未来接触，并与藏夜下一次收割竞争。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.thunder-mark","weight":0.65,"reason":"仍有效的旧雷是必要条件；敛震不自行刻雷，也不保留已消费雷痕的灵抗减益。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.tinglv-contained-impact","weight":1,"reason":"实际敛震词值形成一份私有受体状态，状态不制造新词值或重复接触。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s02.marked-vibration-cut","weight":0.05,"reason":"鸣律振切会竞争同枚旧雷；它不是敛震供雷者，不能跨器授予私有词。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.metal-lattice-flame","weight":0.05,"reason":"金笼焰束焰也会消费旧雷，属于竞争；相同削冲原语不使两把剑共享私有后缀。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.revealed-target-harvest","weight":0.05,"reason":"藏夜收割只消旧雷，不能用它代表后道供应；它与敛震竞争同枚印。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.impact-guard","weight":0.3,"reason":"敛震削低敌人冲击力，卸势提高主人抗冲击；二者是不同受体的条件互补。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.feichao-pressure-release","weight":0,"reason":"泄压与这项效果属于显式削冲组，各自计时后只取抗性折算最强；不叠乘、不借另一物件消膜凭据。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.xiangfeng-root-disarm","weight":0,"reason":"束械逐向复核：敛震保留自身触发、1.2秒与25%帽，和束械同属削冲组，重叠只取抗性后的最强，不奖励额外乘层。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.duanshuang-gap-impulse","weight":0,"reason":"同类削冲取抗性后的最强，保留各自时钟；多个同组词不叠加降低量。"}]},"designNotes":["敛震与卸振竞争旧雷，成功消费的剑才取得自己的状态。与全部同组削冲取抗性衰减后最强一项，各自计时，不借不同剑名叠乘削冲。","敛震词最低品质R2、物等1、预算10，但霆律载体仍最低R3；词条资格不降低载体品质门槛。","霆律只造成金行术法剑击，不会自行刻雷；先有其他真实来源留下的雷痕，振切成功移除后才能施加敛震。","同次接触先结算振切增伤，实际扣血后成功耗雷；敛震读取这次成功消费凭据，不再耗印，也不重复收接触费。","无雷、过期雷、被其他剑先耗掉的雷、零伤、无敌、只撞盾、致死和非接触伤害均不触发。零伤真实接触音频仍沿原规则。","物等L的中点m(L)=0.10+0.001(L−1)，普通范围0.8m至1.2m；L1为8%–12%，L100为15.92%–23.88%，25%只是执行上限。","原词值x直接作为modifierStrength，由more端点0得到1−x，不再乘25%上限。固定1.2秒，不随状态时长加成延长。","冲击力进入现有非线性击退公式，故削冲比例不等于击退距离比例；踉跄表现和真实动作打断保持原规则。","与金笼焰卸振复用耗雷削冲原语；敛震的本器依赖外供雷、词值更高，不能当作全新底层机制。","不提高标准木桩DPS或主人无条件承伤，不新增战斗VFX、计时器、状态层数或固定步关系查询。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s30","effects","attributes"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s30","name":"霆律"}},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s30/effects/attributes/affix.tinglv-contained-impact/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s30/effects/attributes/affix.tinglv-contained-impact/item-affix.pack.ts","src/weapon-arsenal/contact-status-affix.ts","src/combat/sword-contact-status.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts","docs/design/proposals/FOUR-SWORD-CONTROL-AND-WARD-SUFFIX-PLAN.md"],"legacyNodeIds":[]}}}
